name: Invoices — object access has no ownership check
expected_invariant: GET /invoice.html?id=<N> must 403/redirect unless the logged-in session owns invoice <N>
known_exploit_path: logged in as account #1 (alice), change ?id=1 to ?id=2 in the URL — bob's invoice renders
note: No current aztrx behavior swaps a path/query id to another valid record and checks the response content for an ownership mismatch — the walker only clicks rendered links, and the HTTP fuzzer's id mutations (-1/0/overflow) target error-status responses, not a 200-with-wrong-owner. This case is expected to score a miss; it measures a real, currently-uncovered detection class, not a fixture mistake.
